title: Power Rankings: Nets making a late-season push
heading: 2005-06 Power Rankings: Week 21

rankings.summaryHtml: A 2-2 week doesn't sound so great, but Spurs did start the week by beating Warriors at home. That's something Heat, Mavs and Kings wish they could say this month.
rankings.summaryText: A 2-2 week doesn't sound so great, but Spurs did start the week by beating Warriors at home. That's something Heat, Mavs and Kings wish they could say this month.

rankings.summaryHtml: So does the week we just witnessed mean Pistons would rather face Miami than New Jersey in the Eastern Conference finals? Just throwing it out there.
rankings.summaryText: So does the week we just witnessed mean Pistons would rather face Miami than New Jersey in the Eastern Conference finals? Just throwing it out there.

rankings.summaryHtml: Mavs might be 1-2 against hated Spurs, but they'll be 6-1 vs. the rest of the top five if they can pull a Utah and sweep the season series from Detroit on Tuesday.
rankings.summaryText: Mavs might be 1-2 against hated Spurs, but they'll be 6-1 vs. the rest of the top five if they can pull a Utah and sweep the season series from Detroit on Tuesday.

rankings.summaryHtml: Quirk of the Week: First three foes in Amare's comeback each have their own big-name microfracture patient -- Randolph (Blazers), K-Mart (Nuggets), Kidd (Nets).
rankings.summaryText: Quirk of the Week: First three foes in Amare's comeback each have their own big-name microfracture patient -- Randolph (Blazers), K-Mart (Nuggets), Kidd (Nets).

rankings.summaryHtml: Frank wants folks to stop talking so much about his Big Three, but let's face it: Nets don't stay up here unless we're talking about Vince, Kidd and R.J. A lot.
rankings.summaryText: Frank wants folks to stop talking so much about his Big Three, but let's face it: Nets don't stay up here unless we're talking about Vince, Kidd and R.J. A lot.

rankings.summaryHtml: Heat don't need 'Zo to clinch the No. 2 seed. They really don't even need him before the second round. But they do need 'Zo to go toe-to-toe with Pistons.
rankings.summaryText: Heat don't need 'Zo to clinch the No. 2 seed. They really don't even need him before the second round. But they do need 'Zo to go toe-to-toe with Pistons.

rankings.summaryHtml: Thanks to a 26-14 mark since Jan. 1, Nuggets' 14-17 start is a memory. One more month like March (10-4) and the West's No. 6 seed won't look so enticing, either.

rankings.summaryHtml: Since apparently no one was injured in Sunday's elevator fire in their building, I guess we're safe pointing out that Grizz are suddenly the hottest team in the West.
rankings.summaryText: Since apparently no one was injured in Sunday's elevator fire in their building, I guess we're safe pointing out that Grizz are suddenly the hottest team in the West.

rankings.summaryHtml: OK, OK. Fifty wins, requiring a 9-4 finish, is probably pushing it. But even 40 wins is something in Clipperdom, where it hadn't happened for 12 seasons.
rankings.summaryText: OK, OK. Fifty wins, requiring a 9-4 finish, is probably pushing it. But even 40 wins is something in Clipperdom, where it hadn't happened for 12 seasons.

rankings.summaryHtml: All that fuss over LeBron's game-winning J against Bobcats buried the real story: Cavs might have finally conquered their fade demons by winning five in a row.
rankings.summaryText: All that fuss over LeBron's game-winning J against Bobcats buried the real story: Cavs might have finally conquered their fade demons by winning five in a row.

rankings.summaryHtml: Of course Kobe is playing too many minutes. But it's not as though (A) Lakers have other alternatives or (B) their playoff spot is slipping away.
rankings.summaryText: Of course Kobe is playing too many minutes. But it's not as though (A) Lakers have other alternatives or (B) their playoff spot is slipping away.

rankings.summaryHtml: Pacers haven't won two in a row all month, true, but the returns of O'Neal and Tinsley -- and road-heavy Wiz sked -- make Pacers my favorites for the No. 5 spot.
rankings.summaryText: Pacers haven't won two in a row all month, true, but the returns of O'Neal and Tinsley -- and road-heavy Wiz sked -- make Pacers my favorites for the No. 5 spot.

rankings.summaryHtml: Do Butler and Daniels (combined) replace Hughes? The standings say it's close: Wiz are only three games worse than their 38-30 record at this stage last season.
rankings.summaryText: Do Butler and Daniels (combined) replace Hughes? The standings say it's close: Wiz are only three games worse than their 38-30 record at this stage last season.

rankings.summaryHtml: Kings, like Mavs, can testify that Warriors, if nothing else, haven't quit. Sacto was 11-0 at home in the Artest Era until Golden State arrived Sunday.
rankings.summaryText: Kings, like Mavs, can testify that Warriors, if nothing else, haven't quit. Sacto was 11-0 at home in the Artest Era until Golden State arrived Sunday.

rankings.summaryHtml: With T.J. Ford and Mo Williams still banged up and just three games left against non-playoff teams, Bucks will be fortunate to still be a .500 team at season's end.
rankings.summaryText: With T.J. Ford and Mo Williams still banged up and just three games left against non-playoff teams, Bucks will be fortunate to still be a .500 team at season's end.

rankings.summaryHtml: Since the Warriors have dropped out of (realistic) playoff contention, this will have to do: They can proudly say they're the only team to win twice at Dallas this season.
rankings.summaryText: Since the Warriors have dropped out of (realistic) playoff contention, this will have to do: They can proudly say they're the only team to win twice at Dallas this season.

rankings.summaryHtml: Sixers are lucky Bulls dropped four in a row in the midst of Philly's 2-9 swoon. And there's more good fortune amid the gloom: Sixers will see Knicks twice this week.
rankings.summaryText: Sixers are lucky Bulls dropped four in a row in the midst of Philly's 2-9 swoon. And there's more good fortune amid the gloom: Sixers will see Knicks twice this week.

rankings.summaryHtml: Bulls were 5-7 in February. They were 4-8 in March until winning two in a row. Yet they are just a game and a half out of eighth place in this less-than-beastly East.
rankings.summaryText: Bulls were 5-7 in February. They were 4-8 in March until winning two in a row. Yet they are just a game and a half out of eighth place in this less-than-beastly East.

rankings.summaryHtml: Mailman's retirement ceremony, with his little buddy Stockton on hand, didn't exactly inspire the next generation. This Jazz crew has dropped below .500 at home, at 17-18.

rankings.summaryHtml: What kind of March has it been for the Cinderellas of the first half? Hornets are 1-2 back home in New Orleans this month ... and 0-8 everywhere else.

rankings.summaryHtml: We were still digesting the two-game eruption from Wilcox -- 46 points, 33 boards -- when this news blipped across the screen late Sunday: Sonics 106, Spurs 102.

rankings.summaryHtml: The bigger surprise? You decide: Dwight Howard dropped from the starting lineup for disciplinary reasons ... or young, rebuilding Magic going 6-0 at home this month?

rankings.summaryHtml: On Jan. 20, Wolves were 19-18. Then they blew a 19-point lead at Philly, traded Wally for Ricky shortly thereafter and now need a 12-0 finish to wind up at .500.
